note: The machine-readable half of PREREG.md. Every number here also appears in the prose, and test_defense_primary.py asserts the two agree — a constant that drifts from its prereg is the failure this file exists to prevent.
TRIGGER_RULE: new divergent defense plies in NEW_PLIES.jsonl, any corpus mix
BAR_UNITS: points per ply, mover-signed (delta_pts_mover), armed-continuation family

HOMOGENEITY_CHECK.name: G-HOMOG
HOMOGENEITY_CHECK.statistic: champion_game defense mean minus carcasum defense mean
HOMOGENEITY_CHECK.se: sqrt(se_champion^2 + se_carcasum^2), each cluster-robust on GAME (the two corpora share no games)
HOMOGENEITY_CHECK.on_fail: DP-CORPUS-SPLIT: read the two corpus legs separately under the same Holm family; licences attach only to the corpus that clears

BUDGET_PIN.source: E-1a / E-1b, NOT governance/PRODUCTION.yaml (which moved to k16x1376=22016 on 2026-08-30)

NULL_READ_DISTRIBUTION.assumes: true effect 0, se 1.153, PRIMARY tested at 1.96

EXCLUSION.rule: GAME-level. A ply is NEW iff no prior pricing round selected a ply from its game.
